content.name: Julia Kowalczyk
content.title: Senior Account Executive DACH
content.summary: Account executive with nearly ten years in B2B software sales in Frankfurt, focused on payments and cloud infrastructure for the German Mittelstand. Closed €2.3m in new annual recurring revenue in 2025, and handles long, compliance-heavy sales cycles with procurement, IT and works council stakeholders.

experience.title: Senior Account Executive DACH
bullets: Closed €2.3m in new ARR in 2025 (118% of quota) selling sovereign cloud hosting to manufacturers and insurers with 500 to 5,000 employees.
Shortened average sales cycles from nine to seven months by preparing data processing agreements and C5/ISO 27001 evidence before the first technical workshop.
Won a three-year €1.1m contract with a Hessian insurer against two US hyperscalers by positioning German data residency and local support.
Run quarterly account plans with solution engineers and customer success for 22 existing customers, adding €640,000 in expansion revenue.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold payment terminals and online checkout to retailers and restaurant chains in Hessen and Rheinland-Pfalz.
Signed 85 new merchants with combined card volume of €210m a year.
Introduced a pilot-store approach for chains, which turned four pilots into rollouts of more than 30 locations each.
Reached at least 100% of target in 12 of 14 quarters.

experience.title: Inside Sales Representative
bullets: Qualified leads and sold entry-level accounting software licences to tax advisers and small businesses by phone.
Handled Polish-speaking customers in Germany and Poland, building a small segment worth €180,000 a year.
Created a webinar series on e-invoicing that produced 450 leads in its first year.

education.details: Semester abroad at SGH Warsaw School of Economics.

achievements.title: Competitive win
achievements.detail: €1.1m three-year insurer contract won against two large international cloud providers.

achievements.title: Club winner
achievements.detail: Reached the company's top-performer club in 2023 and 2025.
